# Best EV Hotels in Vietnam with Free Charging 2026

*By EV Charging Asia — Your Guide to Electrified Adventures Across Asia*

Vietnam has become one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing EV markets, thanks largely to home-grown VinFast and generous government incentives. In 2026, the country has over 1,500 public charging points, and a growing number of hotels are installing free EV charging as a guest amenity.

For EV-driving travellers, finding a hotel with free charging is the difference between a seamless trip and a frustrating search for public chargers. This guide covers the best hotels across Vietnam where you can park, plug in, and charge overnight for free.

---

## Vietnam's Hotel EV Charging Landscape (2026)

- **VinFast chargers** — Most widespread, free at VinGroup hotels and resorts
- **EVOne** — Private network, pay-per-use at most locations but some hotels subsidise it
- **Hotel-installed AC chargers** — Growing number of independent hotels installing 7–22 kW Type 2 chargers (usually free for guests)
- **Standard 220V outlets** — Available at almost any hotel (slow but usable if you carry a portable EVSE)

---

**Family features:** The connected Vincom Mega Mall has an indoor playground, ice rink, cinema, and dozens of restaurants. The pool on the 5th floor has a dedicated children's section.

**Charging tip:** The VinFast chargers are popular. Reserve your spot with the concierge when you check in. Overnight charging gets you to 100% for a full day of Hanoi exploration.

## Free Charging vs Pay-per-Use: What to Expect

| Type | Cost | Speed | Where to Find |
|------|------|-------|--------------|
| VinFast DC (hotel) | Free | 60 kW | Vinpearl hotels & resorts |
| Hotel-installed AC | Free | 7–22 kW | Independent hotels, rising trend |
| VinFast public | VND 3,000/kWh | 60–180 kW | VinFast dealer network |
| EVOne | VND 3,500–4,500/kWh | 60–120 kW | Malls, public parking |
| Standard 220V outlet | Free (or small tip) | 2.3 kW | Any hotel in a pinch |

**Pro tip:** Vinpearl hotels charge the highest nightly rates but include free 60 kW DC fast charging. That saves you about VND 150,000–200,000 per full charge compared to public chargers. Over a week-long trip, the free charging effectively covers the difference between Vinpearl and a comparable non-Vinpearl hotel.

## How to Book an EV-Friendly Hotel in Vietnam

### Booking.com EV Filter

1. Go to Booking.com
2. Search for your destination (Hanoi, HCMC, Da Nang, etc.)
3. Click "Filters" → "Facilities" → tick "Electric vehicle charging"
4. Check hotel descriptions for charger type and cost (free vs paid)
5. Book with confidence

> 👉 **[Search EV-Friendly Hotels in Vietnam on Booking.com](https://www.booking.com/searchresults.html?ss=Vietnam&filter=ev_charging)**

### What to Ask Before Booking

1. **"Is the EV charger free for guests?"** — Most hotels with chargers offer free charging, but confirm
2. **"How many chargers do you have?"** — A hotel with 1 charger for 200 rooms might be fully booked
3. **"What type of plug?"** — Type 2 (AC) or CCS2 (DC). Bring the right cable
4. **"Can I reserve a charging slot?"** — Many hotels now allow advance booking of EV bays

### What to Bring

- **Type 2 cable** — for hotel AC chargers (7–22 kW)
- **Portable EVSE (granny charger)** — for standard wall outlets as backup
- **VinFast charging card or app** — for VinFast DC charging (free at Vinpearl hotels)

---

## The Verdict: Vietnam's Hotel EV Scene in 2026

Vietnam has become one of the best countries in Southeast Asia for EV-driving travellers. The VinFast ecosystem (cars + chargers + hotels) creates a seamless experience for guests staying at Vinpearl properties across the country. But independent hotels are catching up fast, installing free Type 2 chargers as a competitive amenity.

The sweet spot: Book a Vinpearl resort for your main destination stay (free 60 kW DC charging), and mix in independent hotels with AC charging for variety. With the right cables and a bit of planning, you can drive the length of Vietnam—from Ha Noi to Ho Chi Minh City—without paying a single dong for charging.

faq.question: Which hotels in Vietnam offer free EV charging?
faq.answer: All Vinpearl hotels and resorts offer free 60 kW DC fast charging for guests. Many independent hotels (Hotel de l'Opera, Pan Pacific, Furama, Fusion) also offer free AC charging.

faq.question: Do I need to bring my own charging cable to Vietnam?
faq.answer: Yes, bring a Type 2 cable for hotel AC chargers. VinFast DC chargers use tethered CCS2 cables, no adapter needed. A portable EVSE (granny charger) is recommended as backup.

faq.question: Are VinFast charging stations free in Vietnam?
faq.answer: VinFast public charging stations are pay-per-use (about VND 3,000/kWh). However, VinFast chargers at Vinpearl hotels are free for hotel guests.

faq.question: Can I drive from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City in an EV?
faq.answer: Yes, the 1,600 km journey is manageable with careful charging stops. VinFast DC chargers are available every 100–150 km along Highway 1, and there are EV-friendly hotels in every provincial capital.
